scope: Fix ONLY probe_review.md blocking findings B1, B2, B3; no scientific scope, gate, cap, or analysis change.

blocking_findings_addressed.finding: B1 (Hard standard 4): default real run fetched the dictionary over the network.
blocking_findings_addressed.fix: The urllib fetch branch is deleted entirely; no network-capable import exists in run.py (grep for urlopen/urllib/socket/requests returns zero hits). --dictionary-file is now a REQUIRED pre-staged input for a real run: run() refuses with exit 2 when it is absent, stage_dictionary() refuses with exit 3 when the path is missing, and the same record/file/byte-count/md5 pins (Zenodo 16813698, 12149 bytes, md5 c8d806a021614c6bb9f732756f9701d4) verify the held copy before any cell is read. DICT_URL remains only as documentation of the immutable source the held copy must come from. Staging scope unchanged. README and module docstring updated to the required-input command.

blocking_findings_addressed.finding: B2 (Hard standard 5): pre-access split manifest held anonymous integers, not the frozen case ids.
blocking_findings_addressed.fix: run() now loads and pin-verifies ONLY the phenotype-blind exclusions.csv (take-13 label-blind output) first; freeze_split() writes and sha256-hashes a CASE-IDENTIFIED split_manifest.csv listing the actual analyzed case ids plus the excluded bookkeeping cases (reserved/excluded policy recorded in split_manifest.json) BEFORE the outcome-derived contribution table or census summary is opened -- including before their bytes are hashed for the determinism manifest. After the contribution table is opened, support_provenance_gate() additionally requires exact id-set equality against the frozen manifest ids and records split_manifest_sha256 plus contribution_ids_match_frozen_split_manifest in provenance_gate.json; any mismatch is a discrepancy feeding the pre-registered SUPPORT_PROVENANCE_FAILURE stop, so a count-preserving case substitution is now detectable from the bundle.

blocking_findings_addressed.finding: B3 (Hard standard 1): determinism manifests omitted the dictionary and were absent on the SUPPORT_PROVENANCE_FAILURE path.
blocking_findings_addressed.fix: A single hash_targets dict (three frozen tables + take-13 code evidence + the pre-staged dictionary) feeds both manifests, so every claim-bearing input including the dictionary is hashed at start and end. New finalize_determinism_end() re-hashes all inputs, requires exact agreement with the start manifest (exit 7 on disagreement), and writes AND prints determinism_manifest_end.json; it is invoked on BOTH registered terminal paths -- valid completion and the decision-grade SUPPORT_PROVENANCE_FAILURE stop -- before returning. ProbeFailure exits before completion still fail loudly and produce no summary status, so they cannot masquerade as decision-grade bundles. A new assertion also binds the staged dictionary bytes to the start-manifest hash.
